title: Flat tire removal and spare-wheel installation

requirements.display_name: Hard, level and stable work surface

actions.title: Secure the truck before lifting
actions.instruction: Move the truck to a hard, level location away from traffic, apply the parking brake, place the transmission in P, switch the ignition off, and turn on the hazard flashers.
actions.warning_text: Do not work under a vehicle supported only by the vehicle jack.

actions.title: Chock the wheel diagonally opposite the flat tire
actions.instruction: Chock the wheel diagonally opposite the flat tire so the truck cannot roll while it is raised.

actions.title: Retrieve the jack, tools, and spare wheel
actions.instruction: Remove the jack and tool bag from their storage location and use the spare-tire winch tools to lower and remove the spare wheel from the carrier.

actions.title: Loosen the wheel nuts before lifting
actions.instruction: Loosen the flat wheel's lug nuts before raising the truck, but do not remove them yet.

actions.title: Position the jack at the correct lifting point
actions.instruction: Use the owner-manual diagram for the truck's front or rear jacking point, place the jack squarely at that point, and confirm it is stable.
actions.warning_text: Use only the specified jacking point for the wheel being changed.

actions.title: Raise the truck and remove the flat wheel
actions.instruction: Raise the truck only enough to remove the wheel, remove the lug nuts, and take off the flat wheel.

actions.title: Install the spare wheel and hand-start the nuts
actions.instruction: Place the spare wheel on the hub and hand-start all lug nuts to avoid cross-threading.

actions.title: Lower the truck and tighten the lug nuts in the specified sequence
actions.instruction: Lower the truck until the tire supports the vehicle, then tighten the lug nuts in the star/cross sequence shown in the owner manual. Use the exact wheel-nut torque specification applicable to this truck's wheel equipment.

actions.title: Stow the flat wheel, jack, and tools securely
actions.instruction: Secure the removed wheel and return the jack and tools to their proper storage positions. Recheck the spare-tire installation before driving.
